blocks.h2: Commercial Water Heater Service for Elgin Businesses
blocks.intro: We keep hot water running for:

tiles.body: Busy kitchens can't stop for a cold dish machine or a dead handwashing sink.
Every chair and shampoo bowl draws on the same heater.
Restrooms, break rooms and exam rooms need steady hot water.
Wash stations and break areas on the production floor.

blocks.h2: Commercial Water Heater Repair, Replacement and Maintenance
blocks.intro: Service for the life of the equipment:

steps.body: Commercial gas and electric tanks and tankless units. We find the failed part and price it first.
Sized to your peak demand and scheduled around your hours where we can.
Flushing, descaling and safety checks on a set schedule.

img.alt: Dishwasher rinsing a pan under a pre-rinse sprayer at a stainless steel sink in a busy restaurant kitchen

blocks.intro: Our office at 964 N McLean Blvd is on Elgin's west side, a short drive from downtown and the commercial corridors on both sides of the river.

items.body: Many downtown buildings are a century old. Gas, venting and water connections may have been changed many times. We trace them before sizing a new heater.
Our line is open 24/7, and we work to get a plumber to you as soon as we can.
Flat-rate pricing so you can plan around it.

items.h3: Restaurants on Both Sides of the River

blocks.h2: Commercial Water Heater Questions From Elgin Businesses

items.q: Can you work around our business hours?
items.preview: For planned work, yes, where we can.
items.answer: For a planned replacement or service visit, we'll try to schedule before you open or after you close. For a failure, call any time.

items.q: How do we know what size heater we need?
items.preview: We measure your busiest hour of hot water use.
items.answer: We look at your peak hour: sinks, dish machines, showers or washers running at once and the temperatures they need. Then we size capacity and recovery to match.

items.q: Do you service tankless commercial systems?
items.preview: Yes, including multiple units working together.
items.answer: Yes. We repair, descale and replace commercial tankless units, including multi-unit systems.

items.q: How often should a commercial heater be maintained?
items.preview: More often than a home unit, based on how hard it works.
items.answer: Commercial heaters run longer and wear faster. We'll recommend a flushing and safety check schedule based on your use.

items.q: How much does commercial water heater replacement cost in Elgin?
items.preview: It depends on capacity, fuel, venting and code updates. You get a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the capacity, fuel type, venting and any code updates. We give you a flat-rate price before any work begins.
